text.p: Peruvian telecommunications company Telefonica del Peru said Thursday its president, Rafael Hernandez Garcia, had resigned to attend to his work as a director of parent company Telefonica de Espana.
Telefonica del Peru's current general manager, Manuel Garcia, will replace him, a company statement said.

"The directors of Telefonica del Peru have agreed in a session held today to accept the resignation of their president, Rafael Hernandez, and to name in his place Manuel Garcia, general manager of the company," the statement said.

The resignation of Hernandez, who held the presidency since 1994, "is due to the dedication that his current post in Spain requires at the forefront of a business that is strategic for the company in the period prior to the liberalization of the Spanish telecommunications market," the statement added.

Telefonica del Peru said its outgoing president Hernandez had helped "convert the company into the country's leading company and one of the most efficient telecommunications companys at a world level."
His replacement, Garcia, has served as general manager since November 1996.
